run_sweep_inference_benchmark: run an inference benchmark sweep across different GPU configurations using SLURM job submission
run_sweep_nodes_and_atoms: run a benchmark sweep over different GPU counts and atom counts with SLURM scheduling
run_generate_plots: generate weak scaling and strong scaling plots from aggregated benchmark results
run_collect_and_aggregate_results: collect and aggregate benchmark results from completed SLURM jobs into a single JSON file
run_calculate_node_gpu_distribution: calculate the number of nodes and GPUs per node for a given total GPU count
